title: Tantrums at Ages Two and Three: Understanding and Prevention
description: Four daily lessons for parents of two- and three-year-olds: understanding tantrums, noticing hunger, tiredness and transitions, keeping children safe with few words during a tantrum, and closeness and naming feelings once they calm down, with a calm response that keeps children safe and meets their needs.

primary_reference.info: American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry guidance on tantrums, and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention guidance on child development and safe responses.
